1.consolidated_definition: Encogido. En Puerto Rico se oye siempre este vocablo con g ensordecida. En Canarias engoruñado, S. de Lugo, 98. DRAE: engurrio, tristeza, melancolía.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Constricted. In Puerto Rico, this term is often pronounced with a softened "g". In the Canary Islands, it is referred to as engoruñado, and in southern Lugo, 98. DRAE: engurrio, sadness, melancholy.
